prompt.vi: Dùng render prop: Toggle nhận prop render là hàm (on, toggle) => JSX. Trong App: <Toggle render={(on, toggle) => <button id="b" onClick={toggle}>{on ? 'Mở' : 'Đóng'}</button>} />. Ban đầu nút ghi 'Đóng', bấm thì 'Mở'.
prompt.en: Use a render prop: Toggle takes a render prop that is a function (on, toggle) => JSX. In App: <Toggle render={(on, toggle) => <button id="b" onClick={toggle}>{on ? 'Open' : 'Closed'}</button>} />. Initially the button says 'Closed', after a click 'Open'.
